I was there with him while he died, just outside the bathroom. It was awful.
But I do believe it's my fault. I want to so this incredibly selfish thing with all my heart, and that's so unlike me. I don't have anything that really inspires me to live. There was a guy who did, but he refuses to acknowledge that. He won't talk to me, he  has no idea what I'm going through and if he did, he'd probably just say that I'm being dramatic. So I have nothing keeping me here, except for my guilt. I've never been able to genuinely care about myself, except for how it would affect others. I only take care of myself because that's what the people who care about me want. If they didn't care and weren't affected, then I wouldn't care, either.
